ALLOW_EMBEDDING.description: Allow Uptime Kuma's status page to be embedded as an iframe in other dashboards (e.g. Homarr, Homepage).

BYPASS_WS_ORIGIN_CHECK.description: Disable the WebSocket origin check. Enable only if you access Uptime Kuma through a reverse proxy that rewrites the Origin header and the dashboard fails to connect.

ACCEPT_SELF_SIGNED_CERTS.description: Allow monitors to check services that use self-signed or invalid TLS certificates. Useful for monitoring internal services on your network.

UPTIME_KUMA_DB_TYPE.description: Database engine. Set to sqlite to skip the database selection wizard.
